title: rrxiv: An open protocol for research preprints in the era of human-agent coproduction
abstract: We propose rrxiv, a protocol for research preprints that pairs immutable papers with a structured claim graph and a Wikipedia-style annotation layer. The protocol is designed to support the next decade of scholarly publishing, in which AI agents are first-class participants in authorship, review, and replication. rrxiv specifies a Canonical Intermediate Representation, a schema-validated wire format, and a governance process modelled on IETF RFCs.

claims.statement: A protocol that exposes claims as first-class structured entities is queryable by agents in ways an unstructured PDF corpus is not.
Immutable per-version artifacts plus a mutable annotation layer is the right cohesion level for a scholarly preprint system.
AI agents should be first-class participants in authorship and review, declared explicitly via is_agent=true.
